---
name: Integration proposal
about: Propose a vendor, API, MCP or other integration
title: "[Integration] "
labels: integration
---

## System and use case

Identify the vendor/API and the workflows it enables.

## Authoritative documentation

Link the official API, authentication, rate-limit and license documentation.

## Operations and permissions

List read and write operations, risk class, required approvals and audit events.

## Data and credentials

Describe secrets, personal/customer data, storage and deletion behavior.

## Licensing and distribution

Identify SDKs, schemas, copied examples or assets and their licenses.
